# Static Web Apps' navigationFallback has excluded /robots.txt since it was
# written, but the file never existed — so every crawler asking for it got a
# 404. Found 2026-08-23 while verifying the canonical work.
User-agent: *
Allow: /

# Auth-gated, no search value, and pre-rendering deliberately skips them.
Disallow: /admin

# Signed staging previews of unpublished drafts (T-606). The pages also carry
# noindex; this keeps well-behaved crawlers from even fetching the links.
Disallow: /preview

# Generated by scripts/prerender.mjs from the routes actually written, so it
# cannot advertise a URL that renders the 404 page.
Sitemap: https://hybridcloudworks.com/sitemap.xml
